purpose: List GW008 season 1 competition keys, actions, dates and row counts for trophy derivation
sql: SELECT competition_key, competition_group, sm_action, sm_country, sm_division, MIN(match_date) AS first_date, MAX(match_date) AS last_date, COUNT(*) AS matches FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND ((match_date BETWEEN '2026-03-30' AND '2026-08-29') OR (sm_action='worldcup' AND match_date IS NULL)) GROUP BY competition_key, competition_group, sm_action, sm_country, sm_division ORDER BY competition_group, sm_action, sm_country, sm_division
